answer: Competency exams gate influence: each identity must pass a fresh skill exam before its votes count. Exams come from a large bank, run live under anonymous examiners and graded blind, so answers cannot be copied across identities or bought in bulk. A farm seeking many votes must pass every fake through its own exam, paying a skilled stand-in per fake per cycle. Puppets cannot wander through the gate: the oasis of voting power stays reserved for identities proving ability on demand, and the nebula of fakes thins because exam cost scales with each added identity, while honest agents pay once.
